u.english: If you need an abortion, you'd better get one.

target.text: Se precisarem de um aborto, acho bem que o façam.

translation.text: If you need an abortion, you'd better get one.

u.target: Se precisarem de um aborto, acho bem que o façam.

u.english: You're looking at close to a 90% chance of her miscarrying.

target.text: Tem perto de 90% de probabilidade dela ter um aborto.

translation.text: You're looking at close to a 90% chance of her miscarrying.

u.target: Tem perto de 90% de probabilidade dela ter um aborto.

u.english: And the Republicans, they hate abortion, and they love guns.

target.text: Os Republicanos odeiam o aborto e adoram as armas.

translation.text: And the Republicans, they hate abortion, and they love guns.

u.target: Os Republicanos odeiam o aborto e adoram as armas.

m.english: The world waits to see what General Tshombe will do next.

target.text: O mundo aguarda para ver o que o general Tshombe fará a seguir.

translation.text: The world waits to see what General Tshombe will do next.

m.target: O mundo aguarda para ver o que o general Tshombe fará a seguir.

m.english: - To that final place after life that awaits us all.

target.text: Para esse destino final após a vida que aguarda por todos nós.

translation.text: - To that final place after life that awaits us all.

m.target: Para esse destino final após a vida que aguarda por todos nós.

m.english: Our bags are packed and our carriage awaits.

target.text: As nossas malas estão prontas e a nossa carruagem aguarda-nos.

translation.text: Our bags are packed and our carriage awaits.

m.target: As nossas malas estão prontas e a nossa carruagem aguarda-nos.

m.english: Get out of your car and wait for the transfer.

target.text: Sais do teu carro e aguarda pela transferência.

translation.text: Get out of your car and wait for the transfer.

m.target: Sais do teu carro e aguarda pela transferência.

m.english: Stand down for now and wait for my command.

target.text: Fica quieto por agora e aguarda o meu comando.

translation.text: Stand down for now and wait for my command.

m.target: Fica quieto por agora e aguarda o meu comando.

m.english: Maybe he knows when they go to sleep or he lies in wait.

target.text: Talvez ele saiba quando elas vão dormir ou ele aguarda e espera.

translation.text: Maybe he knows when they go to sleep or he lies in wait.

m.target: Talvez ele saiba quando elas vão dormir ou ele aguarda e espera.

m.english: She's waiting for a decision from the Washington State Supreme Court.

target.text: Ela aguarda uma decisão do Supremo Tribunal de Washington.

translation.text: She's waiting for a decision from the Washington State Supreme Court.

m.target: Ela aguarda uma decisão do Supremo Tribunal de Washington.

u.english: I have a note on the screen, sir, that you're awaiting a call from the decision maker.

target.text: Tenho a informação de que aguarda uma chamada do supervisor.

translation.text: I have a note on the screen, sir, that you're awaiting a call from the decision maker.

u.target: Tenho a informação de que aguarda uma chamada do supervisor.

u.english: Right now, I want you to trust me and sit tight.

target.text: Neste momento, quero que confies em mim, e aguarda.

translation.text: Right now, I want you to trust me and sit tight.

u.target: Neste momento, quero que confies em mim, e aguarda.

u.english: I mean it's one night that every guy in here looks forward to, you know, doesn't want to mess up.

target.text: É uma noite que toda a gente aguarda ansiosamente.

translation.text: I mean it's one night that every guy in here looks forward to, you know, doesn't want to mess up.

u.target: É uma noite que toda a gente aguarda ansiosamente.
